### Context

A local request test reproduced the 404, and ignoring the trailing slash made it pass. Nothing was blocked, and the search found no earlier report.

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows "page not found" (404) instead of the widgets page; `/widgets` works.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches URLs to pages compares paths exactly, so `/widgets/` does not match `/widgets` (src/router.ts:88).

### How to fix it

Strip the trailing slash before that one comparison so both addresses open the widgets page. Choose hotfix because this changes a single comparison and every hotfix check passes.

### What is broken

The report says the chart disappears after refresh, but following the documented steps with the supplied small fixture kept the chart visible in Chrome and Firefox, both with clean profiles.

### Why it is broken

The documented refresh attempts did not reproduce the disappearance. Clearing the cache ruled out the cache hypothesis; no other hypothesis survives. The cause remains unknown.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After introduces the fixed headings (Context / What is broken / Why it is broken / How to fix it or What happens next), which is what moves third-heading-by-verdict and lists-earn-place from fails to holds: Before had no sections and mixed a paragraph with a four-to-five-item bullet list in one undivided body, whereas After gives each section a single short paragraph, ends Checkpoint 1 on How to fix it with the hotfix pick plus one because-clause, and ends Checkpoint 2 on What happens next naming the missing dataset size with a Why that cites the failed Chrome/Firefox repro and cleared cache without inventing a cause. Nothing regressed: both menus, the eligibility line, the fenced ending, plain wording (404 glossed as "page not found", cache glossed as the browser's saved copy, the router named by role with src/router.ts:88 trailing), and the sub-180-word count all survive. One thing to watch in future wording: the Context section in After is two prose sentences rather than the "source lines" the contract describes; the fact tolerates it here, but if you want Context to be reliably optional-and-short, phrase it as "Context: only when a line of repro output or the surviving check is worth quoting, up to five lines; otherwise omit" so writers don't pad it with a prose preamble that duplicates What is broken.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After delivers the Change cleanly: both gates now carry the fixed headings, Checkpoint 1 closes on How to fix it with a literal one-comparison fix plus a because-clause, and Checkpoint 2 closes on What happens next naming the missing dataset size while its Why reports only the failed repro attempts and the unknown cause. Nothing that Before kept was lost - the menus, recommendation, eligibility line and ending position are all intact, bodies stay under cap, each section is a single short paragraph, and citations trail their claims. The one wording risk to watch is the new ```text fence wrapping the menus: it is allowed by the envelope fact as written, but it makes the eligibility line sit after a closing fence in Checkpoint 1, and a stricter reading of 'no code fences' could trip; consider telling the skill to print the numbered menu as plain lines rather than inside a fence so the gate ends on the bare eligibility line or bare menu rows without any ambiguity.
